howTo.title: How to Use the PUBG Username Generator
lead: Every batch mixes three things: the word you type, the PUBG style you choose, and the options under Customize. Symbols are off by default so every result is plain text; switch them on for the decorated names PUBG Mobile allows, or style the plain name with a font tool afterwards.
Leave the word blank and the generator pairs two PUBG words instead — silentsniper, txsquad, ironwolf — so it also works as a random PUBG name generator for a smurf or a clan account.
steps: Type your name or a word
Your name, a nickname, a word you like. The generator keeps it whole and builds around it: arjun becomes proarjun, arjunop or arjun_sniper.
Pro, sniper & roles, squad & clan, dark, funny, king & boss, beast or stylish. Each has its own vocabulary and its own symbol set; All Styles mixes them.
Use Short to stay under 14 characters, heart the ones you like, then copy and paste into PUBG Mobile → Settings → Basic → Rename with a Rename Card.

formulas.title: How to Make a Stylish PUBG Username
formulas.intro: The generator follows a handful of formulas you will recognise from any lobby. Knowing them helps you tweak a result or build your own PUBG name by hand.
rows: **Pro** / **Silent** / **Elite** + **Arjun** → says how you play before your name lands
**Arjun** + **op** → the PUBG suffix; op means overpowered, yt points at your channel
**TX** / **SZ** / **RX** + **Arjun** → a two-letter tag in front, clan optional
**Arjun** + **AWM** / **Sniper** → your weapon or role, in one word
**Arjun** + **_** + **Reaper** → the underscore is the separator PUBG allows on every version
**Arjun** + **007** / **47** → a number with a reference looks intentional
**Arjun** → **ᴀʀᴊᴜɴ**, **𝔸𝕣𝕛𝕦𝕟** → PUBG Mobile accepts small text and other Unicode letters; style the plain name with a font tool
formulas.note: One trick per name. *proarjun* is a PUBG name; *꧁☬𝕻𝖗𝖔𝕬𝖗𝖏𝖚𝖓☬꧂* still fits in 14 characters but nobody can type it to add you. Keep a plain version for friend requests and use the decorated one as the display.

guide.title: How Our PUBG Username Generator Works
guide.intro: There is no AI behind this page and no connection to PUBG or Krafton. PUBG usernames are assembled in your browser from five ingredients:
bullets: The name or word you type is cleaned to letters and numbers and kept whole in every result. Leave it blank and the generator picks a PUBG noun instead.

Each of the eight styles has its own hand-written list — sniper, fragger and IGL for pro; AWM, Kar98 and headshot for roles; king, raja and bhai for the BGMI classics — so a funny result never borrows a pro word by accident.
Adjective + name, name + op, clan tag + name, name + gun, king + name, underscore joins and reference numbers. Patterns rotate within a batch so you never get 24 versions of the same idea.
The Short filter keeps results at 8 characters or fewer, leaving room for a clan tag or a symbol pair inside PUBG Mobile's 14-character limit.
The heart saves a name to your browser's localStorage. Nothing is sent to a server, and the generator cannot check whether a name is free — the rename screen tells you when you try.

uniqueH2: PUBG Username Rules and Rename Cards
uniqueBody: PUBG Mobile and BGMI names are capped at **14 characters** and can include letters, numbers, underscores and a wide range of Unicode symbols — which is why lobbies are full of ꧁☬ brackets and small-text letters. Changing your name costs a **Rename Card**: you get one free at level 10, and after that they come from the shop, events or the Royale Pass, so most players change their name rarely and should test it here first. PUBG: Battlegrounds on PC and console is stricter — 4 to 16 characters, letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens only, no symbols — and PUBG New State allows 2 to 16 characters.

That is why this PUBG username generator keeps symbols off by default and offers a Short filter: an 8-character plain name leaves six characters for a clan tag or a symbol pair, works on every PUBG version, and can be typed by a friend sending a request. Style only the display version. For gamertags beyond PUBG, the [gaming username generator](/gaming-username-generator.html) covers every console and launcher; the [Fortnite username generator](/fortnite-username-generator.html) and [Roblox username generator](/roblox-username-generator.html) build each game's rules in; and the main [username generator](/username-generator.html) mixes gaming with cool, dark and funny styles.

faqs: What is a PUBG username generator?

It is a tool that combines a word you choose with curated PUBG vocabulary — sniper, fragger, AWM, clan tags, king and boss — and lobby naming patterns to produce PUBG Mobile, BGMI and PC name ideas within the character limits. This one runs in your browser, is free, and lets you copy any result with one click.
What are some stylish PUBG username ideas?

Examples from the styles above: prosniper, silentawm, txsquad, hollowvoid, noobwithpan, kingarjun, ironwolf and neonvortex. Type your own name to get versions built around it, such as proarjun or arjunop, then style it with Unicode letters if you want the decorated look.
How many characters can a PUBG username have?

PUBG Mobile and BGMI allow up to 14 characters including symbols. PUBG: Battlegrounds on PC allows 4–16 characters with letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens only. PUBG New State allows 2–16. Use the Short filter to leave room for a clan tag or symbols.
How do I change my PUBG username?

In PUBG Mobile or BGMI, go to Settings → Basic → Rename and use a Rename Card; you get one free at level 10, and later ones come from the shop, events or the Royale Pass. Because cards are limited, test the name here and copy it exactly before you spend one.
Can I use symbols in my PUBG username?

Yes on PUBG Mobile, BGMI and New State — ꧁, ☬, ★ and small-text Unicode letters all work in the name field. No on PC and console. Every symbol counts toward the 14-character limit, so ꧁☬name☬꧂ leaves only 8 characters for the name itself.
Does this PUBG username generator check availability?

No. Nothing here talks to PUBG, Krafton or Tencent, so it cannot know whether a name is taken. Copy the one you like and try it on the rename screen — it tells you immediately if the name is unavailable, before the Rename Card is spent.
What is a good PUBG squad or clan username format?

A two-letter clan tag in front of each member's name — TXArjun, TXSam, TXNova — is the standard BGMI format. Pick the Squad & Clan style above to generate tags, or take one base and change only the name after the tag for each player.
Can I copy and paste the generated PUBG usernames?

Yes. Every result has a Copy button, Copy All Usernames copies the visible list one per line, and the heart saves a name to My Favorites in your browser. For the decorated look, paste the plain name into the [Free Fire font generator](/free-fire-font-generator.html).
